name: fly-dumbbell-one-arm
title: Fly: Dumbbell (One Arm)
primer: This is an exercise for chest strengthening.
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your free hand holding the bench.
Grasp the dumbbell in your other hand and with your forearm parallel to the floor raise your arm in an arc to the middle of your chest.
Once the dumbbell is at the middle of your chest line, slowly lower it along the same path to the starting position.
